name: Duplicate calls
description: The exact same request (provider, method, payload hash) repeated within the short window after a successful response.

name: Missing caching
description: Idempotent requests (GET or deterministic POST) with identical payloads re-sent within the long window after a successful response.

name: Retry storms
description: Repeated identical calls after a non-2xx response, retried faster than the minimum backoff.

name: Oversized payloads
description: Request or response bodies larger than the size threshold (large prompts, unpaginated or over-expanded lists).

name: Unbatched calls
description: Bursts of single calls to an endpoint that has a documented batch equivalent.

name: Repeated context resends
description: Chat requests that resend the same large system/context block on every call (LLM-specific, experimental).

name: High-cost model for small tasks
description: Premium models used for short prompts with short answers where a smaller model is usually sufficient (experimental).
